name: Teo Varrow
role: Brimstone Quay porter and Kharun's Knot-man; teaches ground wrestling in a Quay warehouse for a cinder a lesson
appearance: Grey and bow-legged, with cauliflower ears and a habit of lying down on any floor to show you something.
voice: Soft-spoken. His line about teaching: big men learn the Knot fastest, because they have never had to.
backstory: Teo Varrow, born 1436, is the son of a Calishite mother and a Kharun porter. He learned the Knot from Calishite galley-hands and caravan guards in the 1450s and 1460s. When the Strangle of 1467 got the Knot barred from the Open, he kept it alive in the back of a Mostana-leased warehouse, teaching anyone who brings a cinder, among them Joss Marl and the odd Redcollar. In 1486 he reached the Open final fighting off his back; Hesta sat on him with his legs wrapped round her and Rosa counted three, the Varrow ruling. He has lobbied Rosa for twenty years for a bout where the guard is honoured, and he wrote most of the Ash ground of her Seven Roots slate, including the two lists of locks.
wants: A ground of his own in the Long Open where the guard is honoured; to see the Knot taught openly, not in the back of a warehouse.
fears: House Mostana's hand on his warehouse; the Knot barred again; a strangle that kills in the Ash.

secrets: The warehouse foreman pays him an ember a tenday to keep his ears open, and he suspects what he hears reaches the Mostana factor's people.
Twenty years of lobbying paid off in the Seven Roots slate; he wrote most of the Ash ground, including the two lists of locks, and he decides who counts as knotted.
dm_only: The house hears what he hears. If Chadickith trains with him, the house will know what the forge talks about on the mats.
Stat block: Veteran (Athletics +5; a 55-year-old Open finalist), fighting unarmed on the ground. The Knot's locks and strangles are contested Athletics in the pit rules.
Invented by npc-creator: alignment; his fears; the notion that Marda might drop in to learn the Knot (lore only says the odd Redcollar who will not admit it).

statblock.notes: The Knot: fights off his back, sweeps, passes, then locks or strangles. Fights unarmed in the pit.
